fitapp-description: Fitapp is a cross-platform fitness tracking application built with React Native and TypeScript for Android and iOS. It includes GPS-based activity tracking (km/day), daily/weekly/monthly progress visualization, multilingual support (English and Spanish), light/dark theme switching, and personalized goal generation based on user profile data. Fitapp features interactive bar graphs, real-time statistics, and secure authentication.
vibing-description: Vibing is a modern dating platform designed for real connections. It features user profiles, swipe-based matching, and secure authentication for a reliable dating experience. Vibing enables real-time communication via WebSocket-powered chats, allowing users to engage in instant, fluid conversations. With a sleek, user-friendly interface and robust privacy features.
voicestudio-description: Voice Studio is an AI-powered voice cloning and text-to-speech application. It enables users to clone voices from audio samples and generate natural-sounding speech in multiple languages. The app features real-time voice synthesis, customizable voice parameters, and support for various audio formats. Perfect for content creators, developers, and accessibility applications.
foodscanner-description: FoodScanner is a mobile application for scanning food products and retrieving detailed nutritional information. It categorizes products based on nutritional values such as sugars, fats, and proteins, and displays all additives present in each product. The app includes an extensive additives guide with detailed explanations, making it easy to make informed dietary choices. Works with products from any country.
